title: The Silence Between Us
content:
Sneha looked at Siddu for a moment before speaking.

"Will you continue the story?"

Siddu nodded quietly.

"Yeah..."

He took a deep breath before continuing.

"When Shreya rejected my call, I tried to convince myself that maybe she wasn't in a position to answer."

"So, I decided to call her again the next day."

"I waited until evening."

"Then I dialed her number once more."

"No answer."

"I tried again the following day."

"Still no answer."

"I refused to believe she was avoiding me."

"I kept telling myself there had to be some reason."

"I searched for her everywhere."

"Instagram..."

"WhatsApp..."

"Facebook..."

"Everywhere."

"But she was completely inactive."

A helpless smile appeared on Siddu's face.

"Slowly..."

"I started losing my peace of mind."

"I called every friend I knew."

"I asked whether anyone had spoken to her."

"But everyone gave me the same answer."

"'We don't know anything about her.'"

"I wanted to contact our old classmates."

"But I didn't even have their phone numbers."

"The days passed."

"Eventually..."

"I joined my engineering college."

Sneha listened without interrupting.

"I had achieved the dream I had worked so hard for."

"I met many new people."

"I made some wonderful friends."

"But no matter how happy I tried to be..."

"There was always an emptiness inside me."

"My dream had come true..."

"But the person I wanted to share it with was nowhere beside me."

"I couldn't understand why Shreya was behaving that way."

"I tried every possible way to contact her."

"Then..."

"One day..."

"She blocked my number."

"I stared at the screen for several minutes, hoping it was just a mistake. I refreshed my contacts again and again, but nothing changed. For the first time, it truly felt as though she had erased me from her life."

Silence filled the cab.

"I kept staring at my phone."

"I couldn't understand what I had done wrong."

"Why was she pushing me away?"

"Was everything between us a lie?"

"I had no answers."

"So..."

"I borrowed one of my friend's phone."

"I dialed her number again."

"This time..."

"She answered."

A small smile appeared on Siddu's face.

"For a second..."

"My heart was filled with hope again."

"'Hello?' she said."

"The moment I heard her voice after so many months..."

"I forgot everything."

"I immediately replied,"

"'Hello, Shreya...'"

His smile slowly faded.

"The very moment she recognized my voice..."

There was complete silence.

For a second, I thought she was going to say something.

Then...

The call disconnected.

She had hung up.

"For a few seconds..."

"It wasn't that she couldn't talk to me..."

"She simply didn't want to."

"So..."

"I stopped calling."

"But even though my hands stopped dialing her number..."

"My heart never stopped searching for her."

Time continued to move forward.

The first semester of engineering began.

"I attended classes..."

"Made new friends..."

"Laughed with them..."

"But deep inside..."

"A part of me was still waiting for Shreya."

"Weeks slowly turned into months. Life outside continued moving forward, but inside me, everything had remained exactly where she had left it."

Then one day...

I called Kiran.

After talking for a while, he suddenly asked,

"So... did you ever find out what happened to Shreya?"

I let out a bitter smile.

"No."

I told him everything.

"The unanswered calls..."

"The blocked number..."

"The confusion."

Kiran remained silent for a moment.

Then he suddenly said,

"Wait..."

"I think Rohini is still in contact with her."

The moment I heard those words...

Hope returned once again.

"Really?"

"Yeah."

"They're studying in the same B.Tech college."

I immediately asked him for Rohini's phone number.

He sent it to me.

Without wasting even a second...

I dialed the number.

The phone rang.

Once...

Twice...

Then...

Someone answered.

"Hello?"

Siddu tightened his grip on the phone.

For the first time in months...

For the first time in months... hope returned to my heart. I believed I was finally about to learn the truth behind Shreya's silence.
